style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the crab stays at the boulders, body twisting, spinning and claw-striking every beat, never hopping or crouching; the camera circles around him low at shell height nonstop, new angle and shot size every beat; waves, foam and the crab swarm rush into him; the crab fills at least half the frame, camera close and low, except the three close-up beats
character: the crab: hermit crab, long eyestalks, one oversized claw, wearing a glossy pink ceramic piggy bank with a coin slot as his shell; ONE tiny octopus inspector in a plain peaked cap, big toothy grin, lives inside it, until 6.0 only ONE eye blinking in the slot, tentacle in a white shirt cuff
props: ONE piggy bank; ONE sheet with the single Russian word ШТРАФ in big black letters; A SWARM of tiny crabs
environment: rocky sea edge at low tide: wet ochre boulders with deep cracks, breaking waves, wet sand

audio.delivery: raspy small male voice, nervous, 4.85 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mne ka-ZA-los', ya ot na-LO-go-voy PRYA-chus', o-ka-ZA-los', shto o-NI u-ZHE DA-zhe v moy PAN-tsir' za-LEZ-li
audio.pacing: first word on frame one; 0.0-6.0 one continuous flow, no pause between sentences; after 6.0 not a word, sfx go on

timeline.a: a wave slams in and shoves the piggy-bank crab skidding into the lens, eyestalks and mouthparts filling the frame; ONE eye blinks in the slot
timeline.c: low at waterline, foam on the lens

timeline.a: he scuttles sideways and wedges himself piggy-bank-first deep into a boulder crack, scraping and rattling it; A SWARM of tiny crabs scuttles over the sand in the foreground
a wave smashes into him from the side and spins him out of the crack, claw flailing; spray bursts in the foreground
timeline.c: camera hurls itself at him, low

timeline.a: he scuttles sideways back and forth along the boulder lip, legs a blur, big claw snapping at the slot on his back; the swarm spills over the boulder lip in the foreground
timeline.c: circles the other way, shell height

timeline.a: he hooks his big claw over his back and rattles the piggy bank on it side to side, whole body shaking; the slot eye rattles and glares; foam rushes in the foreground
the octopus squeezes out of the coin slot cap-first, the piggy bank popping off the crab's back; the crab spins round to face him, pale tail bare
the octopus flings ONE ШТРАФ sheet straight into the lens, the word ШТРАФ filling the frame
the sheet slaps over the crab; he rolls sideways across the sand wrapped in it; the swarm scuttles over him
the crab claws the sheet off his face, eyestalks popping through; the octopus climbs back into the piggy bank and tips his cap
a wave sweeps the crab, wearing the ШТРАФ sheet wrapped round his tail like a new shell, into the lens, eyestalks and ШТРАФ filling the frame; behind, the octopus waves his cap from the slot

must_appear: eyestalks fill frame 0.0, wave spins crab 2.05, octopus out of slot 6.0, ШТРАФ into lens 6.8, crab in ШТРАФ shell into lens 9.2
negative_prompt: microphone, extra octopus, slow motion, any spoken word after 6.0, accented Russian, any other text, numbers, subtitles, watermark, English speech, duplicate props, floating objects, zoom, night, cut, scene change, top-down view, aerial view, high angle, a distant crab, a crab hopping or crouching, a pause between sentences, a repeated or added word
